deviations.what: Lattice's neighbour wires are toned down when they pile up, with or without a search. This changes the released viewer's no-search picture in Lattice, which the build's rule and task t4's first criterion ('with no search the frame is byte-identical to today's') forbade. Tumble, Wander and Focus with no search stay identical.
deviations.reason: The owner tried the build on 2026-11-14 and said 'Lattice appears very bright. and a bit pixelated'; measured with no search: 11,710 lit pixels of 57,600, 3,812 near white. Asked whether to tone the wires down when there is no search, the owner answered 'Please do'.

deviations.what: Two pieces of work are added to the search build at the owner's instruction, ahead of their plan tasks: a real-vector demo set from Wikipedia as the standalone page's default, and candidates (3 to 100, default 50) with the reranker keeping the top X (default 20).
deviations.reason: Owner on 2026-11-14: 'Yes, replace the demo default with real vectors. Plus, we need more results, 50 or 100, and add reranker and top x out of that (top 20?)'. The plan cannot take new tasks until the new requirements' honesty conditions are confirmed, and the owner asked for the work now.

deviations.what: While a mode prepares (at start and on entering a view) the cloud keeps its slow turn and the status line shows progress; the picture no longer stands still until the mode is ready. This changes how the released viewer starts with no search.
deviations.reason: On the owner's phone the still picture during preparation read as frozen ('possibly it takes time to start. And I can still move it manually'). Asked whether to keep the view turning while it prepares, the owner answered on 2026-11-14: 'Keep the view turning while it prepares, yes'.

deltas.behavior_text: In Lattice, wires not attached to lit points dim while a search is shown, and crowded wires are drawn fainter with or without a search; the released no-search Lattice picture changed.
While a mode prepares, the cloud keeps a slow turn and the status line shows progress; the picture no longer stands still until ready.

The standalone page opens on 999 real Wikipedia articles instead of the generated set, embedded with google/embeddinggemma-2 (the owner's choice of model during the build); viewer serve --embed asks for that model by default.

Search takes 3 to 100 candidates (default 50); a reranker keeps the top X (default 20); Results goes up to 100; each candidate text sent to the reranker is limited to 2,000 characters, down from 4,000.

Preparation work is cut into pieces of about 4,096 multiply-adds, labels and zoom no longer project full vectors each frame, and Lattice reuses Tumble's fit. Zoom differs from the previous release by up to 3.9e-9 relative and label positions by under 0.01 px.

A new option adaptivePixelRatio, off by default, lowers the drawing resolution when frames stay under 25 per second. Built by a task agent without the owner's approval and switched off by the main agent; the owner left it off.
The packages declare Apache-2.0 AND CC-BY-SA-4.0 instead of Apache-2.0, by the owner's decision on 2026-11-15, because the demo set carries Wikipedia text.
Face the searches follows the view on a mode switch; before, it stayed enabled in Focus until the search next changed.
